title: Matchday 1 — Qatar hold Switzerland with a stoppage-time twist

slides.hook: A stoppage-time own goal rescues Qatar's *first* point. [VERIFY]
slides.note: Group B is wide open after the draw. The next round of fixtures decides who blinks. Trust the *board*.

slides.headline: Embolo's penalty puts Switzerland *ahead* early
slides.body: Sixteen minutes in, Qatar pick up a yellow. A minute later, Embolo steps up from the *spot*. He buries it. Switzerland lead 1-0 at the 17th.

slides.headline: Muheim's own goal *levels* it late
slides.body: Deep into stoppage, the ball turns cruel. Miro Muheim turns it into his own net at 90'+4'. Qatar 1, Switzerland 1. A *point* from almost nothing.

slides.context: Saibari strikes for Morocco on 21', set up by Brahim Díaz. Vinícius answers eleven minutes later. Honours *even*, 1-1.
Irankunda opens on 27', Metcalfe adds the second on 75'. Australia win 2-0, the *clean* sheet intact.
McGinn's 28th-minute strike settles it. Scotland take all three points. *Four* yellows in the match, none red.

slides.note: Tomorrow: Germany vs Curaçao, Netherlands vs Japan & 2 more.

stories.big: Two early yellows, a penalty conceded, and still a point. The board *holds*.

stories.note: Switzerland led from the 17th-minute penalty until Muheim's own goal. ...under protest.
